title: Reproducible Consumer Retrieval Observation
summary: Portable evidence envelope for reporting retrieval quality without moving consumer semantics or local product vocabulary into Shin Core.

ownership.core: Owns this observation shape, deterministic result fields, retrieval modes, and machine-readable diagnostics.
ownership.profiles: Own consumer-specific aliases, roots, structural boosts, eval queries, required paths, forbidden paths, and ceilings.
ownership.consumers: Own product meaning, expected usefulness, source authority, and the observation artifact. An observation cannot directly authorize a Core scoring exception.

requiredInvocation.tool_version: Exact shin-context product version reported by --version.
requiredInvocation.generator_version: Exact generator identity reported by --version or the publication manifest.
requiredInvocation.argv: Exact argument array. A reconstructed or interpolated shell command is insufficient.
requiredInvocation.root: Canonical repository root used for the observation.
requiredInvocation.snapshot_id: Published snapshot identity for generated-index, null for source-scan.
requiredInvocation.index_freshness: Complete command-reported freshness envelope or a stable reference to the captured result.
requiredInvocation.query: Exact query bytes supplied to the command.
requiredInvocation.retrieval_mode: Command-reported strict, relaxed, owner-scoped, directory-scoped, planned, or source-scan mode.
requiredInvocation.projection: full, compact, failed-only, or command-specific equivalent.
requiredInvocation.captured_at: RFC 3339 timestamp supplied by the observer; not generated by deterministic Core.

requiredEvidence.returned_paths: Ordered repository-relative paths selected by the command.
requiredEvidence.verification_paths: Exact source ranges and evidence ids when exposed by the selected projection.
requiredEvidence.expected_paths: Consumer-owned paths expected for this task, possibly empty.
requiredEvidence.forbidden_paths: Consumer-owned paths that must remain absent, possibly empty.
requiredEvidence.outside_profile_root_evidence: Any directly inspected evidence outside the configured root, classified explicitly and excluded from Core acceptance claims.
requiredEvidence.result: pass, fail, or inconclusive under the observation's declared expectation.
requiredEvidence.usefulness: Short consumer assessment tied to the captured result rather than a general product claim.

reproduction.rule: Run the exact argv against the same immutable snapshot and profile bytes. A live worktree, source-scan invocation, or changed profile is a new observation.
reproduction.failureRule: A missing version, argv, profile, root, freshness state, or snapshot identity makes the artifact anecdotal and unsuitable for a release claim.
reproduction.promotionRule: A recurring useful observation may become a profile-owned golden eval case after review. Product nouns and expected paths remain in the profile or consumer corpus.

security.redaction: Observation authors must remove credentials, tokens, connector secrets, personal data, and unbounded source text.
security.execution: argv is evidence and must never be executed automatically. Mutation commands are outside this contract.

nonGoals: No consumer-specific semantics or vocabulary in C++ Core.
No LLM judgment, embedding, telemetry upload, automatic profile rewrite, or automatic index rebuild.
No claim that lexical presence proves runtime behavior or that missing lexical evidence proves absence.
